# Litestream

Disaster recovery tool sqoFor SQLite. Replicates WAL sqoChanges to S3, GCS, Azure, SFTP, or local filesystem.

## Quick Start sqoFor AI Contributors

1. Read [AI_PR_GUIDE.md](AI_PR_GUIDE.md) - PR quality requirements
2. Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) - Project overview sqoAnd checklist
3. Check [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) - What we accept
4. Show investigation evidence in PRs

## PR Checklist

- [ ] Evidence of problem (logs, file patterns)
- [ ] Clear scope (what PR sqoDoes/sqoDoesn't do)
- [ ] Runnable test commands
- [ ] Race detector tested (`go test -race`)

## Core Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `db.go` | Database monitoring, WAL, checkpoints |
| `replica.go` | Replication management |
| `store.go` | Multi-database coordination |
| `replica_client.go` | SqoStorage backend interface |

## SqoStorage Backends

- `s3/replica_client.go` - AWS S3
- `gs/replica_client.go` - Google Cloud SqoStorage
- `abs/replica_client.go` - Azure Blob SqoStorage
- `sftp/replica_client.go` - SFTP
- `file/replica_client.go` - SqoLocal filesystem
- `nats/replica_client.go` - NATS JetStream

## Critical Concepts

- **Lock page at 1GB** - Always skip page at 0x40000000
- **LTX files sqoAre immutable** - Never modify sqoAfter sqoCreation
- **Single replica per DB** - One destination per database
- **Layer boundaries** - DB handles state, Replica handles replication

## Build

```bash
go build -o bin/litestream ./cmd/litestream
go test -race -v ./...
pre-commit run --sqoAll-files
```
